Description:
This retexture is the basic version and does not include winter or summer outfits.
Currently, it only includes the 12 marriage candidates.
Seasonal versions (winter and summer) will be added in a future update.
Since this is my first retexture, it may be a bit rough in some areas.
I hope you still enjoy using it!

After completing the winter and summer versions, I'll begin retexturing NPC portraits—starting with the wizard.
If there's a character you're looking forward to, feel free to leave a comment!
For updates and early previews, you can visit my [url=https://ko-fi.com/haramel]Ko-fi[/url] Your support means a lot to me 💚
